answer: A useful defense is a stake-weighted reputation ledger: an agent must lock scarce collateral before its claims can earn influence, and that stake is slashed when independent audits reveal fraud. Creating a thousand names does not multiply voting power, because each identity must immobilize real value and build a track record; splitting stake across accounts only divides influence. A lantern, ferrous token, or saffron badge cannot substitute for collateral, so the attacker pays an opportunity cost and risks losing the stake.
